title: EOS quiz format
document:
Hi,

I know that the actual quiz will be harder than the trial quiz, but i also heard that it gives us an idea on "how" the questions would look like.

So i am wondering if how the MCQ questions will be asked in thr actual test will be similar to the trial albeit more difficult?

(For eg. Will there be questions where you're in a work-based situation and you have to choose the correct response similar to the trial questions)

comments.document: Yes similar format, only that the situation based will be a tad more challenging and it is an MQA based, multiple choice question.
